result.summary: The page layout is generally coherent, but several visual defects stand out: an empty icon-less button in the header, hard-cut (non-ellipsized) text in the horizontal carousel, an off-screen clipped filter chip, and inconsistent card/thumbnail and favorite-button styling between sections.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right of the header renders as an empty light-gray circle with only a small red notification dot — the icon (profile/notifications/cart) appears to be missing or failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Restore the intended icon asset inside the button and add an accessible label (e.g. 'Notifications') so its purpose is clear.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third item is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') and its card image bleeds off the right edge with no ellipsis or peek affordance, making it look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Truncate titles with an ellipsis, apply consistent horizontal padding/snap so partially visible cards are intentionally peeked, and clip the image to the card's rounded corners.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is clipped at the right edge — a chip after 'Healthy' is only half rendered with its label invisible, so users may not realize the row scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient mask or offset the row so the next chip's label is legible, and keep chips within the container's safe padding.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru card uses a white circle with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button on a single background/icon treatment across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Thumbnail treatments in the 'Fastest near you' row are inconsistent — the first card has a pale gray background while the other two use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image backgrounds/aspect handling (or apply a consistent overlay) so all carousel thumbnails share the same visual weight.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is truncated by the bottom navigation bar with no visible title or metadata, and there is little bottom scroll padding, so it reads as content cut off rather than more content below.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so the last card can fully scroll into view.

issues.description: Low-emphasis gray text such as 'DELIVER TO', delivery fees and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' metadata line has weak contrast against the white background.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text to meet at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio.
